subject: Preboarding screening evidence and training roster - batch delivery
messages:
From: Pamela Song <pamela.song@brightlane.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: audit@brightlane.com
Date: Sat, 10 Apr 2027 08:23:00 -0700
Subject: Request: Preboarding screening evidence and training roster

Hi Karthik,

Thanks for agreeing to help with our control validation for Redwood's onboarding/offboarding controls. As part of the SIG assessment, we need a sample package that covers: 1) background-check summary for hires from the last 12 months (redacted PII ok), 2) proof of security awareness training completion for the same cohort, and 3) onboarding process artifacts that show access provisioning checklists and deprovision triggers.

Could you provide a single zip containing redacted summaries and a CSV roster mapping employee IDs to training completion dates? If possible, please highlight any hires who required manual remediation (e.g., late training, delayed deprovisioning) so we can evaluate compensating controls.

We ideally need the package by Friday PDT so our reviewers can ingest it before next week's SIG review. Thanks — Pamela

--
Pamela Song
Senior IT Auditor, BrightLane Security
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Pamela Song <pamela.song@brightlane.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 12 Apr 2027 09:12:45 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: Preboarding screening evidence and training roster

Hi Pamela —

Thanks for the clear list. We'll assemble a targeted sample (20 hires from the past 12 months) with redacted background-check summaries and the training roster you requested. A couple of notes:

- Background checks: we will include redacted result summaries (no SSNs), and for a small number of third-party screenings we will include vendor report IDs.
- Training: security awareness completion dates pulled from our LMS; will include certificate IDs.
- Onboarding artifacts: access provisioning checklist exports + the deprovisioning playbook section relevant to contractor offboarding.

Marissa will coordinate the redaction and packaging. Aditya — can you confirm we can get the roster CSV and LMS exports by Thursday EOD PDT? I will prepare a short cover memo that outlines the sampling methodology and any remediation exceptions.

Karthik

--
Karthik Iyer
Head of Compliance
Redwood Inference
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 14 Apr 2027 14:08:12 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: Preboarding screening evidence and training roster

Karthik / team —

Quick status update: we've pulled the candidate list and LMS completions. Initial export contains 27 records (I sampled a spread across hiring channels and regions). I'm starting manual redaction now — standard practice: remove SSNs, partial DOBs to month/year, and redact personal email addresses.

Open items for decision:
- Redaction of vendor report IDs: legal prefers truncating the middle (e.g., VEND-****-7890) rather than full removal so auditors can reference reports.
- Exception notes: there are 2 hires with training completion flagged after start date by 6–10 days — one contractor and one full-time. Do we want to include a short remediation note for each in the cover memo?

Attachments referenced: background-check-summary_redacted.pdf (sample redacted summary), RL_Preboarding_Roster_2026-2027.csv (current roster export)

Jordan — looping you in since this touches on an access remediation case you handled; can you add any incident IDs to the memo where relevant (SEC-2345 and SEC-2389)?

Thanks — Marissa

Attachments: background-check-summary_redacted.pdf (redaction sample), RL_Preboarding_Roster_2026-2027.csv (roster export)

--
Marissa Cole
Security & Compliance Program Manager
Redwood Inference
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Pamela Song <pamela.song@brightlane.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 18 Apr 2027 16:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: Preboarding screening evidence and training roster — delivery

Hi Pamela —

Attached is the packaged evidence for your SIG assessment. Summary below:

- evidence-batch-04-18.zip (attached): contains 20 redacted background summaries, a CSV roster mapping internal IDs to training completion dates, onboarding checklists for the sampled hires, and a short cover memo (preboarding_evidence_memo.md).
- RL_Preboarding_Roster_2026-2027.csv: the master CSV export used for sampling (column headers include internal_employee_id, hire_date, role, training_completed_at, certificate_id, redaction_note).
- background-check-summary_redacted.pdf: representative redacted report format (PII removed, vendor IDs truncated as VEND-****-7890).

Notes on exceptions and remediation:
- Two hires had training completed 6–10 days after join date; both were assigned expedited remedial training and managers were notified (see incident references SEC-2345, SEC-2389).
- One contractor had delayed deprovisioning due to cross-account entitlements; access was revoked within 48 hours of detection and an additional control (automated entitlement expiry) has been scheduled for deployment.

Related links: the full folder (read-only) is available at https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1A2b3Cexample and I've filed an internal Jira ticket SEC-4127 to track the entitlement fix.

Please confirm receipt and whether the format works for ingestion. If the auditors need a different CSV schema or additional redaction, we can follow up.

Thanks,
Karthik

Attachments: evidence-batch-04-18.zip, RL_Preboarding_Roster_2026-2027.csv, background-check-summary_redacted.pdf, onboarding-playbook_v3.2.pdf

--
Karthik Iyer
Head of Compliance
